implementation_statement: There were no security policies before 2026, only an employee handbook. POL-02 (P06), which includes the program governance rules, was approved 2026-08-31 and takes effect 2026-09-01. A one-page account procedure (onboarding and termination checklist covering the HMI, portal, SaaS accounts, and door code) is due 2026-09-30.

provider_if_inherited: MSP; SaaS vendors; control system integrator
implementation_statement: The Office Manager requests SaaS accounts and the MSP creates suite and device accounts. Gaps: the HMI has one shared operator login and one engineering login; the integrator portal has one shared login used by integrator staff and the Operations Manager; a former temporary bookkeeper's accounting service login was still active at fieldwork (disabled 2026-07-16); there is no periodic account review.
evidence: Suite and accounting service user exports; HMI user list; portal account page; staff roster
regulatory_driver: C-CHEMICAL-R01 (27.230(a)(8), voluntary benchmark); CISA RBPS 8 measure (account access control)

implementation_statement: SaaS services enforce roles; the accounting service limits bank details to the Owner and Office Manager. Gaps: the HMI shared login can edit recipes and alarm limits; the formulations folder has an 'anyone with the link' share created for the private-label customer.
evidence: Shared-drive sharing report; HMI role settings

implementation_statement: Staff have no local administrator rights on MSP-managed computers. Gaps: the shared HMI operator login has engineering rights (recipes, alarm limits); the Office Manager and Owner both hold the accounting service administrator role.
evidence: MSP endpoint policy; HMI role settings

implementation_statement: SaaS services lock accounts after repeated failed sign-ins (vendor defaults confirmed). Tailored on the HMI: operators are never locked out during a batch; the blend room is staffed during operation and has keypad entry (compensating controls).
evidence: SaaS security settings; tailoring decision in SSP section 6

implementation_statement: The MSP enforces a 10-minute screen lock on laptops and desktops. Tailored on the HMI, which must stay visible during a batch; compensated by the staffed blend room. Gap: the warehouse tablet has no lock.

Gap: the integrator reaches the PLC and HMI through an always-on cellular gateway and its cloud portal with one shared login and no MFA, plus a remote desktop service on the HMI PC with a weak password. Sessions are not approved or logged by the company. Planned: gateway powered off except for sessions the Operations Manager opens and watches (interim, from 2026-09-01); named portal accounts with MFA; remote desktop service disabled.
evidence: Portal account page; HMI services list; walkthrough 2026-07-15
regulatory_driver: C-CHEMICAL-R01 (27.230(a)(8), voluntary benchmark); CISA RBPS 8 measure (remote access)

implementation_statement: Office Wi-Fi uses WPA2 with a shared password, managed by the MSP. Gap found in P07 testing: the guest Wi-Fi is not separated from the office network, and the HMI answered from a guest device.
evidence: Firewall and Wi-Fi configuration export; P07 test 2026-08-11

implementation_statement: Six hazmat employees receive DOT training every three years, including security awareness (last cycle May 2024). Gaps: no cybersecurity or phishing training; the operator hired 2026-04-20 missed the 90-day security awareness deadline (trained 2026-08-14). Planned: annual cyber awareness training and quarterly phishing simulations from 2026-10.

Gap: the Operations Manager and Blend Operators have no training on recognizing a manipulated HMI or PLC. Planned: a one-hour session from the integrator on safe-state steps and signs of tampering, by 2026-11-30.
regulatory_driver: C-CHEMICAL-R01 (27.230(a)(8), voluntary benchmark); CISA RBPS 8 measure (training)

implementation_statement: The suite and accounting service log sign-ins and changes. The portal logs sessions by account, but the account is shared. Gap: the HMI audit trail is switched off, so recipe and alarm limit changes are not recorded.
evidence: Suite audit settings; portal session log sample

control_name: Audit Record Review, Analysis, and Reporting
implementation_statement: Gap: nobody reviews logs. Planned: a monthly 30-minute review of portal sessions, HMI recipe change log (once enabled), and suite and accounting sign-in alerts, with findings to the Owner, starting 2026-10.
regulatory_driver: C-CHEMICAL-R01 (27.230(a)(8), voluntary benchmark); CISA RBPS 8 measure (monitoring)

implementation_statement: An independent OT-experienced consultant assessed 13 controls on 2026-08-10 to 2026-08-12 (P07). POL-02 A.6 requires a yearly assessment.
regulatory_driver: C-CHEMICAL-R01 (27.230(a)(8), voluntary benchmark); CISA RBPS 8 measure (audits)

implementation_statement: Gap: no record of connections. The fieldwork found three: HMI to office network (printing and file copies), HMI to the cellular gateway, and the gateway to the integrator portal. Planned: a one-page connection list in the inventory by 2026-10-31.
regulatory_driver: C-CHEMICAL-R01 (27.230(a)(8), voluntary benchmark); CISA RBPS 8 measure (network architecture)

implementation_statement: Gap: no record of the approved PLC program version, HMI project, or alarm limits. Planned: the integrator documents the current baseline with checksums during the backup project (POAM-004), by 2026-11-30.

Gap: recipe, alarm limit, and PLC changes are made without approval or record; the shared HMI login prevents attribution. Planned: recipe and alarm changes approved by the Owner and entered under a named login; integrator PLC changes only with a written change note.
regulatory_driver: C-CHEMICAL-R01 (27.230(a)(8), voluntary benchmark); CISA RBPS 8 measure (policies and change management)

implementation_statement: MSP removes unneeded software from office computers. Gaps: the HMI PC runs a remote desktop service, a web browser used for email, and file sharing; USB ports are open.
regulatory_driver: C-CHEMICAL-R01 (27.230(a)(8), voluntary benchmark); CISA RBPS 8 measure (disable unnecessary system elements)

implementation_statement: The MSP's tool lists 6 computers. Gap: no inventory of the PLC, HMI PC, gateway, tablet, network devices, SaaS services, or where formulations are stored. Planned: one-page inventory by 2026-10-31.

Gap: the emergency action plan covers spills and fire only. Planned: a short contingency plan from the BIA (P05) with the loss-of-HMI procedure, manual batch rules, handwritten bill of lading steps, and a hurricane checklist, by 2026-11-30.
regulatory_driver: C-CHEMICAL-R01 (27.230(a)(8), voluntary benchmark); CISA RBPS 8 measure (continuity and recovery plans)

implementation_statement: Gap: no backup has ever been restored. Planned: integrator restores the PLC program and HMI project to a spare panel PC and a bench PLC by 2026-12-15; MSP restores a sample shared-drive folder by 2026-09-30, then quarterly.

Gap: one internet line; office phones run over it, and the release reporting call list lives in the phone system. Planned: printed call list and staff cell phones (2026-09-30); cellular failover router (2026-12-31).

The MSP backs up the productivity suite daily with 30 days of versions (not immutable). Gaps: the PLC program, HMI project, and recipes are copied only by the integrator (2023) and a monthly USB export; no offline copy. Planned: weekly recipe and HMI export plus a copy after every change, stored offline and in the cloud backup; integrator delivers current PLC program by 2026-10-31.
evidence: MSP backup report; USB export log
regulatory_driver: C-CHEMICAL-R01 (27.230(a)(8), voluntary benchmark); CISA RBPS 8 measure (continuity and recovery plans)

implementation_statement: Gap: no written recovery steps for the HMI PC or PLC. Planned: a recovery checklist in the contingency plan, with a pre-start check of recipes and alarm limits against the approved baseline before automatic dosing resumes.
Unique accounts in the suite, accounting service, and SDS service. Gaps: shared HMI logins and a shared portal login.
evidence: SaaS user exports; HMI user list

implementation_statement: MFA is enforced in the productivity suite for all users, including administrators. Gaps: the accounting service has MFA only for the Owner; the integrator portal, firewall management login, and backup console have no MFA.
evidence: Suite and accounting MFA settings; P07 test 2026-08-11
regulatory_driver: C-CHEMICAL-R01 (27.230(a)(8), voluntary benchmark); CISA RBPS 8 measure (password management)

implementation_statement: SaaS password rules follow vendor defaults. Gaps: the HMI password and door keypad code have not changed since 2023, including after an operator left in March 2026; the HMI remote desktop password is weak.
regulatory_driver: C-CHEMICAL-R01 (27.230(a)(8), voluntary benchmark); CISA RBPS 8 measure (password management)

implementation_statement: Gap: no cyber incident handling procedure. P08 runbook approved 2026-08-31 covers intrusion into the batch control system; first tabletop due 2026-11-30.
regulatory_driver: C-CHEMICAL-R01 (27.230(a)(8), voluntary benchmark); CISA RBPS 8 measure (incident response)

implementation_statement: The emergency action plan tells staff to call 911 and the Operations Manager for releases. Gaps: no rule for reporting cyber events; release reporting call list kept only in the phone system; no voluntary CISA or FBI reporting step.
evidence: Emergency action plan; P08 notification matrix

implementation_statement: P08 runbook for intrusion into the batch control system and POL-03, approved 2026-08-31.
regulatory_driver: C-CHEMICAL-R01 (27.230(a)(8), voluntary benchmark); CISA RBPS 8 measure (incident response)

implementation_statement: Gap: integrator remote maintenance has no approval, MFA, or session record. Planned with AC-17: the Operations Manager opens each session, watches it, and logs the purpose and changes.

Gap: USB sticks move recipe files between the HMI PC and the office with no scanning. Planned: one company USB stick, scanned on an MSP-managed laptop before each use, until recipe transfer moves to an approved file path.
regulatory_driver: C-CHEMICAL-R01 (27.230(a)(8), voluntary benchmark); CISA RBPS 8 measure (physical access to media)

implementation_statement: Keypad entry, alarm panel, and a locked raw-material room for the hydrogen peroxide totes. Gap: the shared door code was not changed after an operator left.
regulatory_driver: C-CHEMICAL-R01 (27.230(a)(8), voluntary benchmark); CISA RBPS 8 measure (physical access)

implementation_statement: This SSP, approved 2026-08-31.

baseline: Not in Moderate baseline (selected by tailoring)
implementation_statement: The Office Manager was designated Security Coordinator in writing on 2026-08-31; the Operations Manager owns the batch control system. Selected by tailoring because RBPS 8 expects named security officials.

Departing staff return keys and laptops. Gaps: no checklist; shared HMI password and door code not changed after the March 2026 departure; former bookkeeper's accounting login active until 2026-07-16.
regulatory_driver: C-CHEMICAL-R01 (27.230(a)(8), voluntary benchmark); CISA RBPS 8 measure (account access control)

implementation_statement: The first risk assessment (P01) was completed 2026-07-24 using NIST SP 800-30 Rev. 1. POL-02 A.2 requires a yearly update.

Gap: no vulnerability scanning and nobody watches advisories for the PLC, HMI software, or gateway. Planned: quarterly external scan by the MSP; the integrator reports applicable advisories for the PLC, HMI, and gateway each quarter.
regulatory_driver: C-CHEMICAL-R01 (27.230(a)(8), voluntary benchmark); CISA RBPS 8 measure (cybersecurity in the system lifecycle)

provider_if_inherited: MSP; control system integrator; SaaS vendors
implementation_statement: Contracts exist with the MSP, integrator, and SaaS vendors. Gaps: no security terms in the integrator or MSP contracts; no vendor review until the accounting vendor's SOC 2 review in P09; the integrator enabled the AI feature without telling the company.

The MSP firewall blocks unsolicited inbound traffic from the internet. Gaps: the HMI PC is on the flat office network; the cellular gateway is a second path to the internet that bypasses the firewall; guest Wi-Fi is not separated (P07).
regulatory_driver: C-CHEMICAL-R01 (27.230(a)(8), voluntary benchmark); CISA RBPS 8 measure (network architecture)

implementation_statement: SaaS vendors encrypt stored data; laptops are encrypted. Gap: the 2 desktops and the HMI PC (recipes) are not encrypted.

The MSP patches office computers monthly. Gap: the HMI PC has not been patched since 2023, runs an operating system out of mainstream support, and is outside the MSP contract; PLC and gateway firmware are not tracked.
evidence: MSP patch report (July 2026); HMI version check
regulatory_driver: C-CHEMICAL-R01 (27.230(a)(8), voluntary benchmark); CISA RBPS 8 measure (cybersecurity in the system lifecycle)

implementation_statement: The MSP runs antivirus on office computers. Gap: none on the HMI PC; alerts reach the MSP only in business hours. Planned: application allowlisting on the HMI PC (approved by the integrator) and MSP antivirus scanning of the company USB stick.
Gap: no monitoring of the HMI, gateway, or portal. Planned: portal alerts on new sessions to the Operations Manager's phone; MSP alerts on new devices on the office network.
regulatory_driver: C-CHEMICAL-R01 (27.230(a)(8), voluntary benchmark); CISA RBPS 8 measure (monitoring)
